messages.author: 505f87eeb7607479
messages.subject: color rows by binary variable
parts:
Hello,
I'm trying to color the rows of a dataframe according to the value of
a binary variable (interaction, TRUE=blue, FALSE=red), but I have two
problems with my graph:
1) I get a gray intermediate line between each row
2) Instead of blue for TRUE, I would rather use a two-color gradient
(blue downto white, as the row number goes from row 0 to row 134)

Anyone have any ideas? For 1) I think I could also do it using
geom_bar, but I'm not sure how. For 2) I have no idea.

Here's my code:


df <- data.frame(interaction =
c(T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,F,T,F,F,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,F,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T,T))
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x=1,y=as.numeric(row.names(df)),
fill=interaction)) + geom_tile() + coord_trans(y="reverse") +
scale_x_continuous("My Database", breaks=NA) + ylab("Size") +
scale_fill_brewer(pal="Set1"); p
